best_honest_definition: v2 name+official HUC2, at least 3 stream stations, largest subset with at least 8 overlapping catalog years. HUC8-only is exploratory and excluded. 6-year overlap is a documented relaxation, not the honest T2 count.
huc2_rule: Official USGS HUC2 after restoring a missing leading zero on odd-length codes. Not v1's raw first-two-character prefix.
what_this_is: Metadata-only v2 public USGS catalog counts using the largest overlapping station subset.
what_this_is_not: Not a recovery score. Daily temperature values were not downloaded. Sealed temperatures were not opened. Loire and Swiss Aare-Rhine are not counted toward T8 or non-NA sealed.
